name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Biology, French, and Chess go with Bungalow, Greenhouse, and Pavilion, in some order.
Art goes with exactly two of Hale, Bungalow, and Chess.
French goes with exactly one of Cloister, Chess, or Scouts.
English goes with none of Hale, Bungalow, or Robotics.
If either Pavilion does not go with Hale or Bungalow goes with Carver, then either French goes with Greenhouse or Carver goes with Biology.
Art, English, and Pavilion go with Carver, Hale, and Nash, in some order.
